content.short: Sifi enables cross-chain asset trading in a single transaction.
content.description: Sifi's Warp Link enables cross-chain asset trading in a single transaction. This capability supports any combination of splits, swaps, and jumps and addresses the limitations commonly found with traditional DEX aggregators, allowing traders to access the best prices across multiple DEXes. By consolidating cross-chain trades into one flow, Sifi aims to make complex orders faster and more efficient, helping users optimize execution and maximize liquidity across the networks it supports.
